notes.title: [BUG FIXED] Manual fix D3D crash tutorial
notes.notes:
The solution to this problem is as follows:

Download MSI Afterburner

https://de.msi.com/page/afterburner

Select Coreclock, and then adjust its value to between -200 and -250 MHz

Then there is an icon like a tick that will change from unpressable to pressable, click it to save

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944018/bdc92016a225d69e9e2214a144cfd2dfb36abebe.png[/img]

This is due to overclocking of the graphics card caused by the game. According to our data collection, Unreal Engine itself cannot adapt to Nvidia's GPU, so there are crashes from GTX980M to GTX2080.
It is currently known that Unreal Engine has better adaptability to AMD’s GPU

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944018/3e6868ee70835e0206557c67e64d2b8fde9d8701.png[/img]

notes.title: 【V1.6.0.7】Hyperspace update！
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944018/ac6d5eb97111b56dcabe61e6200afb01c8f80f32.png[/img]

This is the starting point for the second week. For the time being, there is only the starting point. After the player obtains the data here, it is one of the important clues for the spread after opening.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944018/c25ae8ef4b37b889f15b2180038bb9599aa82b32.png[/img]

List of transition screens at the starting station!

So let's talk about the other updates! The first is the subsystem. Due to the increase in skills and modes, the button display in the lower-left corner is too complicated. Therefore, we have integrated all the functions in one. You only need to press Alt to call the subsystem:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944018/291385e319c7a36b26736a292011641a75424405.png[/img]

The acquisition of the subsystem can only be started by obtaining two installation packages in AXIOX City. If there is no subsystem, various skills cannot be used.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944018/171378ff22c6218d58bb39390699081f140226fd.png[/img]

A new turret system is added. Generally, when you see this type of button, there must be 1-2 turrets that have not been activated nearby. After activation, the turret activation time is limited. Once the connection is disconnected, it takes 5 minutes to charge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944018/58327187e1b8b2fba75905a92dcd43eb5086cf44.png[/img]

The animation sequence has been updated. Now each map of the theme has an opening animation and subtitles.

There are many other details of the update, you are welcome to explore and discover!

About known bugs:

D3D crash

Solution: Set your screen resolution to 1920x1080 instead of changing the game settings to 1920x1080.

We will fix this problem in a later update.

notes.title: 【V1.4.0.0】System fully rework
notes.notes:
In this updated version, the framework of the entire game has been changed, the old building system has been completely transformed, and the operation interface has become very comfortable. The whole navigation system was re-made, and now the navigation system will display map navigation according to different situations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944018/43aa5d2629d6e96905e2d01f776122512656f98c.png[/img]

In addition to the rework of old things, a lot of different objects have also been added, such as the transportation system. You can use the transportation system to instantly reach very far places.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944018/ff4280458b6defa652478d3b8def7bdd9e2aa5fd.png[/img]

The protagonist increases the amount of blood, hunger, thirst and other values. Once these values ​​become zero, you will continue to withhold blood until death. In the current version, you cannot restore health. Therefore, you must collect a lot of food and water in the city to maintain your life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944018/997976af90b0d8b62b5809b4042d45c80104b7d4.png[/img]

The special effects of the game are also improved in this version. The special improvement is the horizontal plane, as shown in the picture, with underwater vision. The combination of underwater and air is also very real.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944018/1faefcb94cb83fb0ced5ca0e07d432c78c91b49f.png[/img]

This update completely replaces the old map, so the work you made earlier [temporarily] cannot be seen. After the game plot is finished, a nostalgic mode will appear, which is the V1.3 version of the building, and will not do it. Any changes, this is only temporary to make the map disappear. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944018/838e9f13ebc28341a464ee4f84f8f4fd56dcb6d9.png[/img]

notes.title: How to import saves + backup your own saves + bonus saves we made
notes.notes:
First we open the game's settings menu and find the interface as shown

Open file location and find the corresponding folder location based on this path:
/ZLM_Crafter/Saved/SaveGames 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944018/8d1cf15d8075c6eca2466d8436409bb80c63aca9.png[/img]
Compress and save the files in this folder, and back up your own archives according to your personal preferences, and empty all files under the SaveGames path.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35944018/498edbc7adcc97b39e8f95fdb5a469992c587505.png[/img]
Download our official saves:
Google Drive: [url=https://drive.google.com/open?id=1XUHuQjpE0nlTfsk3hFQErYJkZ2QMRfgq]https://drive.google.com/open?id=1XUHuQjpE0nlTfsk3hFQErYJkZ2QMRfgq[/url]

Extract the file and delete the .txt extension file

Open the game and enjoy the saves of the lighthouse we made in our official live broadcast. Below is the live video playback of our lighthouse on November 4th, 2019(Mandarin VO):
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PLjh7lvm3EY

notes.title: ZLM Crafter builder simulation release!
notes.notes:
This game is a film related game project that u can get this game, if you support our WR film project. Basically, You can create your own building in this game, such as a castle, a forge, hangar or maybe factory! Build whatever you want!  

Everything you can find in main menu at [b]CONTROL[/b] tab.  If you have any question, please contact our support email.

But this game has the connection with our [url=https://zlmcrafter.com/war-robots-film-project]film project[/url], if we made some 3D scene that is relative with the film, we will add this scene into the game and you can create your own building with the film story. Craft like a main character!

And the last! Enjoy our world and thanks for supporting our Film Project!
